citation: French et al. (2024), Table 3, reproducing Karkoschka (2001), Voyager paper Table V. Adopted axes also appear in the companion HST paper, Table IV.

projectedRadiusKm.definition: sqrt(A B), distinct from volume-equivalent radius

orientation: IAU BODY709; the published prolate interpretation assumes the long axis toward Uranus and repeats B on the third axis.
qualification: Published 92 × 74 × 74 km shape approximation. The third axis repeats the minor axis by the prolate model assumption; it is not an independently measured axis. The standard grid marks unavailable mapped surface imagery, not observed terrain or albedo. Reported uncertainties belong to projected radius and axis ratio; no independent axis uncertainties are invented.

ringInferredMass.interpretation: Inferred from the amplitude of a satellite-forced ring mode, with model assumptions; not the table row computed using assumed density.
